d:
We’re looking for an Expert Gameplay Programmer to join one of our unannounced projects currently in development at 11 bit studios.
This position requires working in a hybrid model in our Warsaw office.

What will you be doing on a day-to-day basis?

• Planning, prototyping, developing and maintaining gameplay features,
• Participating in the gameplay feature design process and working closely with designers,
• Evaluating new technologies and identifying opportunities to apply them to gameplay code,
• Debugging and optimizing gameplay code,
• Analyzing technical risks and requirements for gameplay solutions,
• Enforcing good programming practices within the programming team,
• Sharing knowledge and experience within the programming team.
